Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

content.content:
We need to create a week-long travel plan (7 days) for 5 people, departing from Marquette, visiting 3 cities in Michigan between March 6-12 2022. Budget $14,600. Need accommodations suitable for children under 10. Must create plan per day and call submit_day_plan for each day (7 calls). Need to include city, transportation, breakfast, attractions, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to choose 3 cities in Michigan. Starting point Marquette (Upper Peninsula). Maybe travel to Sault Ste. Marie, Mackinac Island, Detroit? That's 3 cities. Or Grand Rapids, Lansing, Detroit. But include child-friendly attractions.

We need to plan transportation between cities. Could be car rental. Provide details.

Accommodations child-friendly: hotels or cabins.

We need to ensure budget: total $14,600 for 5 people for 7 days. Approx $2,086 per day; seems fine.

We'll produce plan:

Day 1 March 6: Marquette - depart to Sault Ste. Marie (approx 2.5h drive). Breakfast at hotel in Marquette. Lunch en route or in SSM. Dinner. Accommodation in SSM.

Day 2 March 7: Sault Ste. Marie - explore attractions: Soo Locks, River of History Museum, etc. Stay same.

Day 3 March 8: Travel to Mackinac Island (drive to St. Ignace then ferry). Transportation: drive to St. Ignace (approx 3h), ferry to island. Breakfast on road. Lunch on island. Dinner. Accommodation on island (family resort).

Day 4 March 9: Mackinac Island attractions: Fort Mackinac, Butterfly House, bike ride. Same accommodation.

Day 5 March 10: Travel to Detroit (ferry back, drive to Detroit ~4h). Breakfast. Lunch on road. Dinner in Detroit. Accommodation child-friendly hotel.

Day 6 March 11: Detroit attractions: Detroit Institute of Arts, The Henry Ford Museum (in Dearborn), Detroit Zoo. Dinner.

Day 7 March 12: Return to Marquette? That's far (approx 10h). Could instead have day 7 in Detroit and depart later. But requirement is week-long travel plan between March 6-12 inclusive (7 days). Possibly end in Detroit and then fly/drive back later. We'll assume they return to Marquette on day 7.

Day 7: Travel back to Marquette (drive). Breakfast on road, lunch, dinner at home. Accommodation maybe "Home".

We need to call submit_day_plan for each day with required fields.

Fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

Breakfast: "The Jolly Pumpkin Café, Marquette". Attraction: "-". Lunch: "Soo Frontier Café, Sault Ste. Marie". Dinner: "The Bluebird Café, Sault Ste. Marie". Accommodation: "Holiday Inn Express & Suites Sault Ste. Marie (Family Suite), Sault Ste. Marie". (Child-friendly).

Marie". Lunch: "The Mill, Sault Ste. Marie". Dinner: "Kohl's House, Sault Ste. Marie". Accommodation same.

Day 3: travel to Mackinac Island. current_city: "Sault Ste. Marie to Mackinac Island". transportation: "Rental Car to St. Ignace, then M-57 Ferry, Departure St. Ignace 09:00, Arrival 09:45". Breakfast: "Jolly Pumpkin Café, Sault Ste. Marie". Attraction: "-". Lunch: "The Pink Pony, Mackinac Island". Dinner: "The Grand Hotel Main Dining Room, Mackinac Island". Accommodation: "Grand Hotel Mackinac Island (Family Suite), Mackinac Island".

Day 4: stay in Mackinac Island. current_city: "Mackinac Island". transportation: "-". Breakfast: "Grand Hotel Breakfast, Mackinac Island". Attraction: "Fort Mackinac, Mackinac Island; Mackinac Island Butterfly House & Insect World, Mackinac Island". Lunch: "The Red Snake, Mackinac Island". Dinner: "Mike's Place, Mackinac Island". Accommodation same.

Day 5: travel to Detroit. current_city: "Mackinac Island to Detroit". transportation: "Ferry to St. Ignace, then Rental Car to Detroit, Departure 08:00, Arrival 13:00". Breakfast: "Grand Hotel Breakfast, Mackinac Island". Lunch: "The Hudson Café, Detroit". Dinner: "Buddy's Pizza, Detroit". Accommodation: "Cambria Hotel Detroit Downtown (Family Suite), Detroit".

Day 6: Detroit day. current_city: "Detroit". transportation: "-". Breakfast: "The Hudson Café, Detroit". Attraction: "Detroit Institute of Arts, Detroit; The Henry Ford Museum, Dearborn; Detroit Zoo, Detroit". Lunch: "Café at The Henry Ford, Dearborn". Dinner: "Selden Standard, Detroit". Accommodation same.

Day 7: return to Marquette. current_city: "Detroit to Marquette". transportation: "Rental Car, Departure 08:00, Arrival 18:30". Breakfast: "Buddy's Pizza (breakfast option) or local café, Detroit". Lunch: "Lakeview Restaurant, Marquette (on arrival)". Dinner: "Home". Accommodation: "Home in Marquette". Could also put "-".
